生成された動画：=== CHARACTERS ===

RIVEN:

Use the provided female character image for Riven.

Riven is now grown up after many years of practicing swordsmanship with her father.

She is confident and highly capable with a sword, but she has not yet experienced real warfare.

Her swordsmanship is controlled, practical, and grounded.

Keep her appearance natural and coherent throughout the scene.

Riven does not speak.


RIVEN'S FATHER:

Use the provided male character image for Riven's father.

He is a quiet former warrior who has trained his daughter for many years.

At this point, Riven no longer needs basic instruction from him.

He simply watches her practice from nearby.

He does not speak.


=== ENVIRONMENT ===

Use the provided village environment image for the location.

The scene takes place beside Riven's family cottage in a peaceful medieval-fantasy mountain village.

There is a familiar dirt-and-grass training area beside the cottage.

Nearby are the old tree, stacked firewood, chopping area, village road, surrounding cottages, green valley, and distant mountains.

Soft natural daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

Subtle chimney smoke.

Quiet rural life.

The village is peaceful and safe.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Natural human movement.

Grounded physical interaction.

Realistic sword weight and momentum.

Realistic footwork.

Realistic cloth and hair movement.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Patient pacing.

Restrained editing.

No rapid montage.

No age transformation.

No supernatural movement.

No magical effects.

No exaggerated acrobatics.

No flashy sword choreography.

No dialogue.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No intelligible background conversations.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.

Natural audio:

gentle wind,
birds,
quiet village ambience,
boots against dirt,
sword moving through air,
Riven's controlled breathing,
distant horse hooves,
subtle armor and equipment sounds.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Open with Riven already practicing swordsmanship in the dirt-and-grass area beside her family cottage.

Many years have passed since her childhood.

Do not show the passage of time directly.

Do not show Child Riven.

The audience should understand that time has passed simply by seeing how naturally Riven now handles a sword.

Her father stands nearby and quietly watches.

Riven performs a short sequence of practical sword movements.

Her stance is stable.

Her footwork is precise.

Her movements are controlled.

The sword has realistic physical weight.

Riven completes the sequence cleanly and returns to a balanced stance.

Her father does not correct her.

He simply watches.

Then distant horse hooves become audible.

Riven hears them.

She stops training and looks toward the village road.

A small group of medieval-fantasy soldiers is traveling peacefully through the village.

They are not attacking.

They are not threatening anyone.

They are simply passing through.

Riven becomes quietly fascinated by them.

She watches their armor, weapons, horses, disciplined movement, and confident posture.

These people clearly come from a world beyond her isolated village.

Riven looks at the sword in her own hand.

Then she looks back toward the departing soldiers.

Her father notices the way she is watching them.

He looks at Riven rather than the soldiers.

He quietly understands that something has changed.

No one speaks.

Riven does not approach the soldiers.

Riven does not follow them.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — YEARS LATER

Begin close on a sword moving through the air.

The blade passes cleanly through frame.

Reveal Riven practicing beside her family cottage.

She is already in motion.

Riven performs one controlled diagonal cut.

She recovers naturally.

She changes her footing.

She performs another practical sword movement.

Keep the choreography simple and believable.

Do not make this a flashy action sequence.

The important visual idea is that Riven is now completely comfortable with the weapon.

The sword has physical weight, but she knows how to control its momentum.

Riven performs one final controlled movement.

She stops cleanly.

Returns to a stable stance.

Remains balanced.

Her breathing is controlled.

Reveal her father standing nearby.

He has been quietly watching.

He does not correct her.

He does not give instructions.

He simply observes.

Then distant horse hooves break the quiet atmosphere.

Riven hears them.

She turns her eyes toward the village road.

She lowers the sword slightly.

CUT.


Shot 2 — THE SOLDIERS

Follow Riven's attention toward the road.

A small group of medieval-fantasy soldiers travels through the peaceful village.

Some walk.

Some may travel slowly on horseback.

Their armor is practical and weathered.

Their weapons are carried naturally.

Their equipment moves realistically as they travel.

Their movement is disciplined and organized.

They are peaceful travelers.

They do not threaten villagers.

They do not behave aggressively.

Ordinary village life continues around them.

Riven watches from beside her cottage.

She studies the soldiers quietly.

Her attention moves across their armor.

Their weapons.

Their horses.

Their disciplined movement.

They clearly belong to a larger world beyond this valley.

Nothing dramatic happens.

The importance of the moment comes from Riven's reaction.

CUT.


Shot 3 — BEYOND HOME

Return to Riven.

She stands silently with her sword lowered beside her.

The soldiers continue farther along the village road.

Riven follows them with her eyes.

Her expression is thoughtful and curious.

Keep the emotion subtle.

No broad smile.

No exaggerated excitement.

No heroic pose.

Riven briefly notices a soldier carrying a sword while walking with the group.

She looks down at the sword in her own hand.

Hold naturally.

Nothing magical happens.

Then Riven slowly raises her eyes again.

She looks toward the soldiers disappearing farther down the road.

The road continues beyond the village toward the open valley.

Gentle wind moves Riven's hair and clothing.

Her attention remains fixed on the world beyond home.

Now show her father nearby.

He looks at Riven.

He notices that she is no longer thinking about training.

He understands what has captured her attention.

Keep his reaction restrained.

No sadness.

No smile.

No sentimental reaction.

Riven does not notice him watching.

The soldiers continue away.

No dialogue.

No additional action.

Hold the final composition with Riven standing at home while looking toward the road leading beyond the village.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven remains beside her family cottage with her sword in hand.

Her father stands nearby.

The soldiers continue disappearing along the road beyond the village.

Riven silently watches them leave.

She does not approach them.

She does not follow them.

She does not make a verbal decision.

Her father notices her fascination with the world beyond home.

End in silence.


=== MOOD ===

Warm.

Grounded.

Reflective.

Quietly ambitious.

The scene should communicate one simple progression:

Riven has grown up and become skilled with a sword.

She trains confidently.

She hears approaching horses.

A group of soldiers passes through her village.

She watches them.

She looks at her own sword.

She looks back toward the road beyond home.

Her father notices.

Do not add another story event.

Do not have Riven leave home yet.

Do not have the soldiers recruit her.

Do not portray the soldiers as villains.

End with Riven becoming curious about the wider world.、16:9
